name: Persimmon Place
summary: Persimmon Place is a well-regarded community shopping center on Dublin Boulevard, serving the affluent Tri-Valley area with a convenient mix of retail, dining, and services. With extended operating hours and a strong 4.3-star rating from over 2,300 reviews, it has established itself as a popular destination for Dublin's growing residential community.
demographics: Persimmon Place serves the affluent Dublin community in the Tri-Valley area, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $120,000 to $200,000+. The primary shopper demographic consists of families aged 30-55 with children, along with young professionals who appreciate the convenience of the center's location along Dublin Boulevard. The trade area draws from Dublin's well-educated population, with many residents working in nearby tech hubs and seeking quality retail and dining options close to home.
description: Persimmon Place is a prominent community shopping center located along Dublin Boulevard in the heart of Dublin, California, serving the thriving Tri-Valley region. This well-established retail destination has become a cornerstone of the local community, offering residents convenient access to a diverse mix of shopping, dining, and service options. The center's strategic location in one of the Bay Area's fastest-growing suburban communities has made it a popular gathering place for families and professionals alike. With operating hours from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, Persimmon Place accommodates early morning shoppers and evening diners, reflecting the busy lifestyles of its clientele. The center maintains a strong reputation in the community, as evidenced by its 4.3-star rating from over 2,300 reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and its role as a trusted retail destination in Dublin.
